title: Sum of Digit Differences of All Pairs
summary: Given an array of positive integers with equal digit lengths, calculate the total count of differing digits at the same positions across all possible pairs of integers.
statement: Given an array of positive integers with equal digit lengths, calculate the total count of differing digits at the same positions across all possible pairs of integers.
constraints: nums contains at least two positive integers and all have the same decimal digit length.
For every unordered pair, count positions where their decimal digits differ.
Return the sum of those counts over all unordered pairs.
hints: At one position, each new number differs from all earlier numbers except those with the same digit.
Scan positions and numbers, maintaining counts of previously seen digits at that position.
For item index i add i-count[digit], then increment count[digit]; sum across positions.
Every unordered pair is counted once when its later member is processed, exactly at the positions where the two digits differ.
editorial: Every unordered pair is counted once when its later member is processed, exactly at the positions where the two digits differ.

tests.explanation: The pairs differ in 1, 1, and 2 positions respectively, totaling four.
All digits match at every position, so the total is zero.
